data.description:
Yanggu 2026 is the sixth of the seven UMB 3-cushion World Cups of the 2026 season and the penultimate event of the year, before Hurghada in December. It runs for seven days, from 2 to 8 November, at Yanggu Sports Town in Gangwon-do, South Korea - the first World Cup held in the province.

The 149-player field works through four qualifying rounds before the main tournament: the PPPQ and PPQ rounds in groups of three to 30 points with equalizing innings (2-3 November), the PQ round to 35 points (4 November) and the Q round to 40 points (5 November). The 1/16 round then places 32 players in eight groups of four at 40 points (6 November), and from the last 16 the event runs as a straight knockout at 50 points without equalizing innings, with the final on Sunday 8 November.

Ranking points follow the standard World Cup scale: 80 for the winner, then 54, 36, 26, 18, 10 and 8. The tables are Hollywood, the cloth Simonis 330 Prestige, the balls Aramith Prestige. The event is organised by the UMB with the Asian Carom Billiard Confederation and the Korea Billiards Federation.

Myung Woo Cho arrives as world number one and as the winner of three of the five World Cups decided in 2026 (Bogota, Ankara and Lier), with Frederic Caudron winning Ho Chi Minh City and Eddy Merckx Porto. Cho also won the Korean World Cup in 2025, after Merckx in 2023 and Dick Jaspers in 2024. Every match, score, high run and standing is published on this page as the event progresses.
